front: Genes sit at fixed places on {{c1::chromosomes}}, and each body cell has two copies of most of them, one from each parent.
One gene can have many alleles in a population, though each person carries at most {{c1::two}}.
{{c1::Dominant}} alleles hide the effect of recessive ones.
When does a recessive allele show?
back: Only when both copies of the gene are recessive
